boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, source-backed University of Arizona library environments for quiet reading, group work, computer tasks, and project-based study.

cards.title: Silent Study Room
cards.subtitle: Main Library, room C318
cards.notes: Bring reading or offline work and silence every device before entering; the room’s rule is no sound, including whispers, keyboards, or headphones.
cards.short_summary: A first-come Main Library room designed for absolute silence.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Library’s Silent Study Room is C318 on the third floor and is first come, first served during open hours; no sound is permitted.
cards.source_title: Silent study room | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: First come, first served when the library is open; room C318 is on Main Library’s third floor.

cards.title: Scholars’ Corner
cards.subtitle: Main Library, A220
cards.notes: Use the CatCard entrance on the second floor and choose a window seat for individual work or a small, low-key conversation with collaborators.
cards.short_summary: A 14-seat, naturally lit room with monitors and an adjacent patio.
cards.evidence_claim: Scholars’ Corner in Main Library room A220 has large windows, natural light, LCD monitors, seating for up to 14, and permits small-group work.
cards.source_title: Scholars' Corner | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: For UA graduate students, honors undergraduates, and faculty; first come, first served during open hours. CatCard access required.

cards.entity_name: Main Library Quiet Study Area, Floor 4
cards.title: Main Library Quiet Study Area — Floor 4
cards.subtitle: Main Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for a quieter session, keep mobile devices silent, and save any extended conversation for the floor lobby.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Main Library floor with seating and whiteboards nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Library floor 4 is a designated quiet-study floor; quiet-study areas include comfy seating and whiteboards and are first come, first served when open.
cards.source_title: Quiet study areas | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available first come, first served when the library is open; speak quietly and limit louder conversation to the floor lobby.

cards.entity_name: Main Library Quiet Study Area, Floor 5
cards.title: Main Library Quiet Study Area — Floor 5
cards.subtitle: Main Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: Settle in on the fifth floor for focused reading or writing, silence your phone, and take calls or louder collaboration back to the lobby.
cards.short_summary: A separate quiet floor above Main Library’s fourth-floor study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Library floor 5 is a designated quiet-study floor, where the Libraries direct users to speak quietly, silence mobile devices, and use the lobby for louder conversation.
cards.source_title: Quiet study areas | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available first come, first served when the library is open.

cards.entity_name: Weaver Library Quiet Study Area, Floor 1
cards.title: Weaver Quiet Study Area — Floor 1
cards.subtitle: Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose the first-floor quiet area for independent work, keep devices silent, and use the floor lobby if your discussion needs more volume.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study floor inside the science and engineering library.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library is a designated quiet-study floor with seating and whiteboards in several areas.
cards.source_title: Quiet study areas | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available first come, first served when the library is open; follow the quiet-area expectation for devices and conversations.

cards.entity_name: Weaver Library Quiet Study Area, Floor 4
cards.title: Weaver Quiet Study Area — Floor 4
cards.subtitle: Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Use this upper-floor quiet area for concentrated coursework; silence mobile devices and move calls or louder project talk to the floor lobby.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet option near Weaver’s assigned and family study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library is a designated quiet-study floor, and the library lists quiet study there among its floor services.
cards.source_title: Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available first come, first served when the library is open; quiet-study guidance asks users to silence devices and keep conversations quiet.

cards.title: Main Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Library, multiple floors
cards.notes: Reserve a room before meeting your group, then use the table, chairs, and whiteboard to outline tasks, review notes, or plan a presentation.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with standard collaborative furniture and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: UA students can reserve Main Library group study rooms, which have tables, chairs, and whiteboards, for up to four hours at a time.
cards.source_title: Group study rooms | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: UA students, faculty, and staff may reserve up to four hours at a time and 24 total hours weekly; unreserved rooms are first come, first served.

cards.title: Weaver Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library, multiple floors
cards.notes: Book a Weaver room for a small project session and make the whiteboard your shared agenda; release the space if your group will not arrive.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms distributed across Weaver’s science and engineering library.
cards.evidence_claim: UA students can reserve group study rooms at Albert B. Weaver Science-Engineering Library; standard rooms include tables, chairs, and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Group study rooms | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve up to four hours at a time and 24 hours weekly; reservations are forfeited after 15 minutes, and unreserved rooms are first come, first served.

cards.title: Maker Studio
cards.subtitle: CATalyst Studios, Main Library B203
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or prototyping, then drop in to use the studio; ask staff about equipment before starting unfamiliar work.
cards.short_summary: A walk-in maker environment for hands-on academic projects.
cards.evidence_claim: CATalyst Studios’ Maker Studio is in Main Library B203 and can be used without a reservation for projects involving equipment such as 3D printing, sewing, laser cutting, and more.
cards.source_title: CATalyst Studios spaces | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is needed for the Maker Studio. Entry to the makerspace and surrounding studios has no membership cost; some materials have charges.

cards.title: Virtual Reality (VR) Studio
cards.subtitle: CATalyst Studios, Main Library B202
cards.notes: Use the drop-in VR studio when a course project needs immersive media; check with staff on equipment availability and any setup needed for your session.
cards.short_summary: A walk-in CATalyst space for virtual-reality and multimedia projects.
cards.evidence_claim: CATalyst Studios’ Virtual Reality Studio is in Main Library B202, supports virtual-reality and multimedia projects, and does not require a space reservation.
cards.source_title: CATalyst Studios spaces | University of Arizona Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservation is needed for the space. CATalyst says it is open to everyone, although some equipment or materials may have separate requirements or costs.
